.link-survey-page { min-height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 2rem 0px; background: var(--background-secondary, #fafafa); }.link-survey-app { max-width: 640px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 2rem; font-family: var(--font-font-family, inherit); }.survey-card { background: var(--background-primary, #fff); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 1px 3px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04) 0px 4px 12px; }.survey-card--centered { padding: 2rem 1.5rem; text-align: center; }.survey-end__icon { display: block; margin: 0px auto; }.survey-end__icon--dismissed { color: var(--content-secondary, #707070); }.step-view { padding: 1.5rem; }.step-view__header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; margin-bottom: var(--layout-gap); }.step-view__title { margin: 0px; font-size: 1.125rem; color: var(--content-primary, #1a1a1a); }.step-view__blocks { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }.step-view__nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; }.step-view__step-counter { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: rgb(136, 136, 136); }.step-view__nav-buttons { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; flex: 1 1 0%; justify-content: flex-end; }
